messages.content: I want to buy apples, rice, and 12 pack of bottled water from a Walmart near San Jose. Show me the product information and stock availability.

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

We need to call the function walmart_purchase with loc "San Jose" or maybe "near San Jose". Provide product_list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"] and pack_size [None, None, 12] or maybe just provide pack_size [12] for bottled water? So we need to provide pack_size array of same length as product_list. For apples and rice, no pack size needed; we can set pack_size to [0, 0, 12] or maybe null? But the type says number[]. We could set pack_size: [0, 0, 12]. Or maybe we can omit pack_size entirely? It says default is not use it if not specified. But if we specify pack_size, it should match length. Let's include pack_size: [0, 0, 12] meaning no pack size for first two. That might be acceptable.
